title: Bava ben Buta and the flock in the Azarah
summary: Whether a korban olah may be brought on Yom Tov, and how Bava ben Buta brought his flock to the Azarah so the halachah would follow Beis Hillel. Also why one may not invite a non-Jew to a Yom Tov meal, a lesson from Esther's banquets, and Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah's cow that went out with a strap between its horns.

key_ideas: Bava ben Buta brought his own flock to the Azarah so the halachah would follow Beis Hillel.
A non-Jew may not be invited to a Yom Tov meal.
Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah fasted until his teeth turned black for not protesting a neighbor's wrongdoing.
One sincere sigh from a Jew can bring a person to teshuvah.
